quotes.text: PayPal redirects you back to Stripe where you can check the status of your integration
Stripe sends email updates about the progress of onboarding requests.
Connect platforms and connected accounts can’t switch PayPal accounts.
Payments continue to flow through your previous account until the new account is successfully connected.
After switching PayPal accounts, payments processed with your previous account are still eligible for refunds and disputes.

you must re-enable recurring payments and collect mandates from buyers again.

findings: Both captures allow eligible Stripe accounts in the EU except Hungary, plus Liechtenstein, Norway, UK and Switzerland, to activate PayPal via the Stripe Dashboard. Select settlement to Stripe balance or retain PayPal balance and manage PayPal payouts there, with optional automated payout frequency. Connect an existing or new PayPal account, return to Stripe and inspect integration status.

After linking, pending can reflect unconfirmed PayPal email or further PayPal verification. Both dates direct users to contact Stripe Support if those possibilities do not apply. Return and linking are separate from an approved/usable integration.

Eligible Connect configurations require a Dashboard request, Stripe confirmation email, AUP or terms and documentation of seller controls, and PayPal representative phone/email follow-up. Stripe sends progress emails and displays onboarding status in settings. The same-date companion overview further documents marketplace-only support, a joint Stripe and PayPal review and the charge types. It omits email detail without contradicting activation’s explicit email guidance.

Ordinary merchants can switch an existing or newly created PayPal account. Connect platforms and connected accounts cannot switch. The previous account keeps processing until the new account is successfully connected, and then previously processed payments still qualify for refunds/disputes. A new account can remain pending for email or PayPal verification. Where recurring was enabled, switching disables it and requires re-enable plus recollecting customer mandates.

List renumbering, heading whitespace, Dashboard capitalization and buyer/customer wording are editorial. The acceptance-guide route continues as navigation. The two dated captures show no evidence of changed behavior.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain May 7 and November 7 evidence for the two payout branches, the linked-but-pending boundary, Connect onboarding and notification, account-switch cutover, prior-transaction servicing and conditional recurring mandate renewal.
conflicts: Mapped source line 29 says switching is not immediate but omits the operative cutoff (previous account continues until successful connection of the new one) and post-cutover refund/dispute eligibility for prior payments, explicit on both dates. Its recurring statement should state the prior-enabled condition.

Mapped source line 27 retains the initial confirmation email but omits the distinct progress emails and Dashboard onboarding status. Both activation captures document them, while the November overview mentions status but is silent on emails.

Activation source and concept give the full eligibility list. Inbound PayPal index, Wallets source caption and Stripe company caption shorthand EU excluding Hungary without naming four other documented countries. Qualify these labels.
unresolved_questions: The guide does not establish specific PayPal verification criteria, a time to clear pending, successful approval for an account or transaction outcome after switching.

findings: Retain the existing activation and Connect summary while adding the return-to-status step, optional PayPal payout frequency, distinction between confirmation and progress notices, cutoff and previous-payment servicing. Date both full authorities.
conflicts: Source line 29 compresses material cutover and servicing boundaries and omits the prior-enabled condition for recurring. EU shorthand in incoming captions obscures four non-EU account locations.
source_assessments.reason: No functional change in the raw comparison. The mapped summary independently omits meaningful account cutover, onboarding and recurring qualifications visible in both captures.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/activate, source-stripe-paypal-activate.md covers eligible European Stripe accounts turning on PayPal in payment-method settings, choosing Stripe-balance settlement or PayPal-balance settlement with PayPal-managed payouts, and linking an existing or new account. Old raw lines 8–19 and new raw lines 9–20 say PayPal returns the merchant to Stripe, where pending can mean unconfirmed PayPal email or further verification. Old raw lines 21–31 and new raw lines 22–32 distinguish compatible Connect onboarding through a Dashboard request, initial Stripe email, policy and seller-control documents, PayPal representative review and progress updates. Old raw lines 33–55 and new raw lines 34–56 bar Connect switching, route new payments to the old account until successful connection and preserve refund/dispute eligibility for past payments. A merchant with prior recurring enablement must re-enable it and recollect mandates.
